column2: Retain sickness to death, Isaiah's full identification, instructions for the household and the paired dying/not-living declaration. The warning is not softened in anticipation of the later healing.
Retain turning his face to the wall and prayer to the Lord. The trailing comma properly opens the prayer in the following stored unit.

Retain direct divine Thee/Thine, truth, full heart and good deeds, followed by intense weeping. I pray Thee expresses the petition particles rather than a separately expressed prayer verb; bitterly is an inherited contextual description of great weeping.
column3: Would an expression of intensity without bitterly more precisely represent the cognate weeping construction?

column2: Retain Isaiah in the middle courtyard and the coming of the Lord's word. No alternative city location or before-he-left temporal clause is imported.
Retain return, Hezekiah as leader of My people, David's God, heard prayer, seen tears, behold, healing and third-day ascent. Human you remains ordinary within divine speech.
Retain fifteen additional years, rescue of both king and city from Assyria and shielding for the Lord's and David's sake. The paired beneficiaries and repeated city remain.
Retain the unexpressed speaker as he, plural taking and applying a fig cake, the ulcer and future recovery. No narrated application or completed healing is substituted for the command and promise.
Retain Hezekiah's sign question, healing by the Lord and third-day ascent to the Lord's house. The repeated third day is not dropped.

Retain the selected conditional if the shadow returns ten steps rather than rewriting it as a choice between forward or backward. The Lord's sign and fulfilment of His spoken word remain explicit. The fresh English-route source was accessible; earlier German-route access history is unchanged.
column3: How should the conditional be construed in context, and what does an apparatus comparison establish? No variant is adopted here.

column2: Retain the easy inclination of ten steps, the rejection and the imperative return ten steps backward. This response is not used to rewrite the preceding conditional into a different reading.
Retain Isaiah's cry to the Lord and the shadow's return ten steps on the stairway. The selected text does not name Ahaz or describe a solar instrument, so neither is supplied.
Retain Marodachbaladan son of Baladan, Babylon, plural letters, manaa and the report of illness. Manaa remains the inherited opaque gift/tribute term pending lexical resolution.

Retain rejoicing, the whole house of the nechotha, silver, gold, spices, fine oil, equipment house and treasures, together with exhaustive showing. Rejoiced follows the selected Greek, not a listening variant; authority expresses the domain provisionally.
column3: What does nechotha designate, and should all his authority be rendered as all his dominion for clearer English?

column2: Retain Isaiah's two questions about speech and origin and Hezekiah's distant-land/Babylon answer. The repetition from a land/from Babylon is preserved.
Retain the question about what was seen, everything in the house, the negative exception clause and also the treasuries. The unexpressed alternating speakers remain intelligible from the dialogue.
Retain Isaiah's command to hear the Lord's word, leaving its content in the next stored unit. No additional title is inserted.

Retain behold, coming days, all household and ancestral treasures taken to Babylon, and no word which the Lord spoke left over. The selected word-relative-clause construction is not silently harmonized to nothing remains, says the Lord.
column3: Does word left over mean an unfulfilled pronouncement, or does the difficult syntax require another construction? Apparatus and lexical review remain pending.

column2: Retain the singular he shall take, sons coming forth and begotten, and their becoming eunuchs in Babylon's royal house. The unnamed taker is not replaced by a plural they or a supplied Babylonian king.
Retain the good word which He spoke and the wish for peace in my days. The selected third-person spoke and peace alone are not replaced by you spoke or peace and truth.
Retain deeds, all might, fountain, aqueduct, bringing water into the city and the chronicle question. The waterworks are named without adding an engineering reconstruction.
Retain lying with the fathers, explicit burial in David's city and Manasseh's succession. The burial clause in this selected text remains.
Retain Manasseh's age twelve, fifty-five-year reign in Jerusalem and mother Opsiba. These names and numbers await no harmonizing alteration.
Retain evil in the Lord's eyes and conformity to the expelled nations' abominations. The Lord is the agent of the earlier removal.

Retain rebuilding the demolished high places, one Baal altar, plural groves, the Ahab comparison and worship/service of all heaven's host. Rebuilt represents return plus building contextually without implying only a single restored site.
Retain a singular altar in the Lord's house and the quoted placing of His name in Jerusalem. He is contextually the Lord in the speech attribution, though the Greek does not repeat the divine noun.
Retain a singular altar for all the heavenly host within two courts. The altar is not made plural to fit the two locations.

Retain plural sons through fire and the distinct divinatory activities, charmer and knowing ones. The inherited divination from sounds interprets the first verb provisionally; no specific modern practice or harmless generic superstition replaces the list.
column3: How should the two divination verbs, theletes and knowing ones be distinguished using contextual lexical evidence?

column2: Retain the carved grove image, the house, speech to David and Solomon, chosen Jerusalem and the enduring name. The antecedent house remains distinct from the city selected from all tribes.

Retain not again shaking Israel's foot from the given land and the obligation to keep all commands through Moses. For those who keep is an inherited interpretation of the difficult relative construction, not an explicit Greek if-clause.
column3: How does the future relative who shall keep attach to Israel, fathers and the land promise, and is the inherited for those construction accurate English?

column2: Retain refusal to listen, Manasseh's misleading agency and evil exceeding the nations the Lord destroyed. The comparison is qualitative rather than an added count of offences.
Retain the Lord speaking through His servants the prophets. Through represents the hand-of agency idiom without suggesting the prophets originated the declaration.

Retain the causal accusation, evil abominations beyond the earlier Amorite's deeds and Judah's induced sin through their idols. The plural their remains rather than assigning the idols exclusively to Manasseh.
Retain not so, the Lord Israel's God, behold, approaching disasters and both ears ringing for every hearer. The abrupt not so is not replaced with therefore from another textual tradition.

Retain Samaria's measure, Ahab's house's weight, an alabaster jar and repeated wiping before overturning on its face. Weight is provisional for the measurement term; neither a plate nor a plumb line is silently substituted.
column3: Does the measurement context require plummet rather than weight, and what vessel sense is intended by alabastros?

column2: Retain rejection of the inheritance's remnant, delivery into enemies' hands and the paired plunder/booty outcomes for all enemies. The Lord remains the explicit acting speaker.
Retain evil in My eyes and provocation extending from the fathers' exodus through this day. The repeated temporal endpoints remain instead of a vague long-standing accusation.

Retain abundant innocent blood and filling Jerusalem from end to end, alongside the sins inducing Judah's evil. End to end renders the mouth-to-mouth extent idiom without an invented exact victim number.
Retain deeds, everything done, the singular sin committed and the question about Judah's royal chronicles. The sin clause is not omitted from the regnal summary.
Retain lying with the fathers, burial in his house's garden identified as Oza's and Amon's succession. No temple or city-of-David burial is substituted.
Retain Amon's age twenty-two, two years in Jerusalem and Mesollam daughter of Arous from Jeteba. The selected maternal lineage and place forms remain provisional.
Retain evil in the Lord's eyes and the comparison with Manasseh his father. No mitigating conduct is added from another account.
Retain every paternal way, repeated idol service and bowing down. The three linked actions are not collapsed into a generic faithfulness-to-father summary.
Retain abandonment of the Lord, God of his fathers, and failure to walk in the Lord's way. The negative path statement remains distinct from serving idols.
Retain Amon's servants conspiring and killing the king in his house. No motive or identity beyond servants is supplied.
Retain all the land's people, all conspirators, their striking down and making Josiah king. The popular agency is stated twice in the selected narrative.
Retain Amon's remaining deeds and behold within the chronicle question. The presentative is explicit here rather than inserted for register.
Retain burial in his tomb in Oza's garden and the repeated Josiah succession. The repetition following verse 24 remains part of the regnal closing.
